newsitem.title: USA: El Paso Electric ordered to file rate case.
newsitem.headline: El Paso Electric ordered to file rate case.

text.p: El Paso Electric Co said on Monday that the New Mexico Public Utility Commission issued an order requiring the company to file a general rate case by December 9, 1996.
El Paso said in a statement that it was ordered to file additional information to address rate issues raised in complaints by two Dona Ana County residents.
The company said that it has not filed for a rate increase since the expiration of a rate agreement in 1994.
Company officials were not available to elaborate.
